Sargent 1431, Thru-Bolt Parallel Mounted Door Closer

The Sargent 1431 Powerglide Door Closer is a parallel arm closer (Mounts on Push Side of Door) designed for institutional and other high traffic applications. They are normally thru-bolt mounted.

Specifications and Features for the Sargent 1431 Series Powerglide Commercial Door Closer:

  • Aluminum Powder Coated.
  • Trough Bolted
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Closer Body Length: 12"
  • Forged Steel Arm 11-1/4" long.
  • Hold open from 75° - 180°
  • Piston Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Non-Handed
  • All weather fluid.
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • Spring Size: 1-6
  • UL 10C listed for positive pressure fire test.
  • UL / cUL listed for use on fire rated doors.
  • 25 year limited warranty.
  • High impact non-corrosive plastic covers with two machine screws .

Sold Individually
